name: item
title: Item
description: A composable row for list and feed content — media, title, description, actions — with a highlighted flash for a just-changed row.

meta.whenToUse: A row of structured content in a feed, list, or panel — a person, file, notification, or settings link — with optional media and trailing actions. Rows rendered as links or buttons can sit inside an ItemGroup (the list item moves to a wrapper), and ItemGroupLabel names a group.
meta.whenNotToUse: Tabular/sortable data with columns (use Table or DataList) or a zero-data placeholder (use Empty).
